climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A Victorian zone from the South Australia border to Ballarat, containing the regions Grampians, Henty and Pyrenees. Pinot Noir leads plantings, followed by Cabernet Sauvignon, Chardonnay and Shiraz.
